title: KBRA Affirms Ratings for Banner Corporation
summary: Banner Corporation (NASDAQ: BANR) (“Banner”), the parent company of Banner Bank, today announced that Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC (“KBRA”) affirmed the senior unsecured debt rating of BBB+, the subordinated debt rating of BBB, and the short-term debt rating of K2 for Banner Corporation. In addition, KBRA affirmed the deposit and senior unsecured debt ratings of A-, the subordinated debt rating of BBB+, and the short-term deposit and debt ratings of K2 for the company's principal subsidiary, Banner Bank. The agency also noted they again determined the outlook for all of Banner’s long-term ratings is Stable. “We are pleased KBRA has once again affirmed our investment-grade rating,” said Mark Grescovich, President and CEO. “The reaffirmation of our rating and stable outlook underscores our financial strength, disciplined credit practices and consistent performance.
